title: P18.6 — Semantic-First Goal Understanding + FINAL closure: guarded evidence binding, item-bound approval resolution, strict snapshot scope + IDENTITY closure: structured issue keys (entity/quantity/scope swaps are never the reviewed issue), accept-vs-supplied decisions, approval endpoint ownership+lifecycle authority
description: P18.6 IDENTITY closure on base cabd25d (post-#155 main) - hardens the F2 approval-resolution binding over the semantic-goal-understanding diff. statementCoveredBy's >=60% token-overlap coverage accepted entity/channel/quantity/project swaps as 'reviewed' (telegram vs email subscriber target, telegram vs youtube budget, differing quantities). Now approvals bind structured ISSUE IDENTITIES: issueKeyFor(item) = category + exact discriminating-token set (generic issue-shape words filtered EN+VI); every material-driving UNRESOLVED item in the confirmed revision's pinned analysis must be covered by an approved issue with identical category + issue_key; swaps are never the reviewed issue. Owner decisions distinguished: resolutions[] records accepted_assumption vs supplied_value (bounded operator text; supplied for non-approved id or empty fails closed; decisions fold into revision_digest so changed decisions are a different amendment). Endpoint authority: approveGoalIntentItems enforces READY preview lifecycle + non-null authenticated operator + preview operator ownership (FAIL_CLOSED_PREVIEW_STATE / FAIL_CLOSED_OPERATOR_ID_REQUIRED / FAIL_CLOSED_GOAL_INTENT_OPERATOR). verifyGoalIntentApproval re-derives item_statements AND approved_issues from the pinned analysis (tampered row fields fail closed). Genuine approve->amend->re-preview->confirm preserved (generic rephrasing of the same issue still covers). Adversarial probes: swap variants over HTTP + real confirm seam. Prior closures (guarded evidence binding, strict snapshot scope) unchanged. Baseline P18.6: versioned GoalIntentAnalysis via ONE bounded provider request; interpretation ADVISORY only (canonical extraction/coverage/F10/operatorGoalOf sole authority); OFF default; no auto-merge.
